# Enceladus: A Moon Shooting Ice Geysers into Space

Backlit by the Sun, Saturn's icy moon Enceladus reveals spectacular plumes of water and ice shooting from its south pole—dramatic fountains that hint at a hidden ocean lurking beneath its frozen crust. These cosmic geysers are so bright and icy that they make the moon shine like fresh snow and even feed Saturn's outer ring, while nearby Pandora glimmers faintly in the reflected glow of Saturn itself.
